FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_H2Station_DualPressureCascade
(*
====================================================================================================
  TITLE: IEC 61131-3 HIGH-PRESSURE HYDROGEN (H2) DUAL-PRESSURE DISPENSER & CASCADE CONTROL
  DOMAIN: 350-Bar (H35) / 700-Bar (H70) Dual-Pressure Cascade Bank Switching & Micro-Channel Chiller
  COMPLIANCE: SAE J2601 / SAE J2799 / ISO 19880-1 / IEC 61508 SIL-3 TMR Architecture
  AUTHOR: Principal Automation Fellow & Cyber-Physical Systems Chair
====================================================================================================
*)

VAR_INPUT
    bStationEnable          : BOOL;     (* Global dispenser station enable permissives [1=Enabled] *)
    bEmergencyStop          : BOOL;     (* Safety instrumented system dual-channel E-Stop loop [Active High] *)
    eTargetProtocol         : INT;      (* Dispensing protocol class: 1=H35 (35.0 MPa), 2=H70 (70.0 MPa) *)
    rPT_VehicleTank_1       : REAL;     (* 2oo3 Redundant Vehicle Pressure Transmitter Ch 1 [bar] *)
    rPT_VehicleTank_2       : REAL;     (* 2oo3 Redundant Vehicle Pressure Transmitter Ch 2 [bar] *)
    rPT_VehicleTank_3       : REAL;     (* 2oo3 Redundant Vehicle Pressure Transmitter Ch 3 [bar] *)
    rTT_PreChill_1          : REAL;     (* 2oo3 Redundant Micro-Channel Chiller Temperature Ch 1 [deg C] *)
    rTT_PreChill_2          : REAL;     (* 2oo3 Redundant Micro-Channel Chiller Temperature Ch 2 [deg C] *)
    rTT_PreChill_3          : REAL;     (* 2oo3 Redundant Micro-Channel Chiller Temperature Ch 3 [deg C] *)
    rPT_Bank_Low            : REAL;     (* Low-Pressure Cascade Storage Bank Pressure [bar] *)
    rPT_Bank_Mid            : REAL;     (* Medium-Pressure Cascade Storage Bank Pressure [bar] *)
    rPT_Bank_High           : REAL;     (* High-Pressure Cascade Storage Bank Pressure [bar] *)
    rMassFlowRate_H2        : REAL;     (* Coriolis Mass Flow Meter Delivery Rate [kg/min] *)
    rAmbTemperature         : REAL;     (* Station ambient dry-bulb temperature [deg C] *)
    rVehicleTankVolume_L    : REAL;     (* Target vehicle onboard type-IV composite storage volume [L] *)
    bBreakawayCoupled       : BOOL;     (* Safety breakaway sensor loop [TRUE = Mechanically Intact] *)
    bNozzleInterlocked      : BOOL;     (* High-pressure fueling receptacle 350/700 mechanical interlock *)
    bInfraredCommValid      : BOOL;     (* SAE J2799 IrDA optical vehicle communication link [TRUE = Synced] *)
    rVehicleReportedTemp    : REAL;     (* IrDA Transmitted Internal Vehicle Tank Gas Temp [deg C] *)
    rVehicleReportedPress   : REAL;     (* IrDA Transmitted Internal Vehicle Tank Gas Pressure [bar] *)
    rCycleTime_dt           : REAL;     (* Task cycle scan execution interval [s] (e.g., 0.01s for 100Hz) *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    bSystemReady            : BOOL;     (* Dispenser permissive healthy and ready to initiate fueling *)
    bDispenseActive         : BOOL;     (* Active hydrogen injection into vehicle storage envelope *)
    bDispenseComplete       : BOOL;     (* Successful completion of refueling cycle per target SOC *)
    bFaultTrip              : BOOL;     (* Critical safety trip lockout condition active *)
    wAlarmWord_01           : WORD;     (* Critical Process Alarm Bitfield [Overpress, Overtemp, Breakaway] *)
    wAlarmWord_02           : WORD;     (* Diagnostic and Warning Bitfield [Sensor Drift, APRR Warning] *)
    wSystemStatusWord       : WORD;     (* Operational Dispenser State and Bank Selection Telemetry *)
    rTargetRampRate_MPamin  : REAL;     (* Dynamic SAE J2601 Target Average Pressure Ramp Rate [MPa/min] *)
    rActualRampRate_MPamin  : REAL;     (* Real-time differentiated and filtered fueling ramp rate [MPa/min] *)
    rVFD_ChillerSpeed_Pct   : REAL;     (* Micro-Channel Heat Exchanger Chiller Compressor Command [0-100%] *)
    rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct   : REAL;     (* Dispenser High-Pressure Control Valve FCV-101 Command [0-100%] *)
    bBankValve_Low_Open     : BOOL;     (* Low Bank Isolation Control Valve Command (XV-101) *)
    bBankValve_Mid_Open     : BOOL;     (* Mid Bank Isolation Control Valve Command (XV-102) *)
    bBankValve_High_Open    : BOOL;     (* High Bank Isolation Control Valve Command (XV-103) *)
    bVentValve_Open         : BOOL;     (* Emergency Depressurization / Safe Bleed Down Valve (XV-104) *)
    rCalculatedSOC_Pct      : REAL;     (* Real-time State of Charge estimation per SAE J2601 [0-100%] *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       STATE MACHINE ENUMERATION / CONTROLLER STATES
       --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    iState                  : INT := 0; (* Primary Dispenser Sequencer State *)
    iPreviousState          : INT := 0; (* Transition tracking register *)
    tStepTimer              : TON;      (* Step dwell and stabilization timing engine *)
    tPulseTimer             : TON;      (* Pressure pulse verification timer *)
    tLeakHoldTimer          : TON;      (* High-pressure static leak evaluation timer *)
    tBankSwitchHoldTimer    : TON;      (* Interlock dwell during cascade bank transition *)

    (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) VOTING INFRASTRUCTURE
       --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rVoted_VehiclePressure  : REAL;     (* Validated 2oo3 median vehicle pressure [bar] *)
    rVoted_ChillerTemp      : REAL;     (* Validated 2oo3 median pre-chill temperature [deg C] *)
    bTMR_PT_Discrepancy     : BOOL;     (* Pressure sensor divergence flag (> 5.0 bar threshold) *)
    bTMR_TT_Discrepancy     : BOOL;     (* Temperature sensor divergence flag (> 3.0 deg C threshold) *)
    bTMR_PT_Channel1_Fault  : BOOL;     (* Ch 1 Pressure sensor out-of-bounds or outlier *)
    bTMR_PT_Channel2_Fault  : BOOL;     (* Ch 2 Pressure sensor out-of-bounds or outlier *)
    bTMR_PT_Channel3_Fault  : BOOL;     (* Ch 3 Pressure sensor out-of-bounds or outlier *)
    rPT_Diff12              : REAL;
    rPT_Diff23              : REAL;
    rPT_Diff31              : REAL;
    rTT_Diff12              : REAL;
    rTT_Diff23              : REAL;
    rTT_Diff31              : REAL;

    (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       STATE-SPACE SYSTEM DYNAMICS MATRICES (A, B, C, D)
       Model of Micro-Channel Evaporator / Gas Pre-Cooling Process
       States: x1 = Micro-channel metal wall temp [deg C], x2 = Exit H2 gas temp [deg C]
       Input:  u1 = Chiller refrigerant expansion valve / VFD bypass [%]
       Disturbance: w1 = H2 Mass flow rate [kg/min]
       x[k+1] = A*x[k] + B*u[k] + E*w[k]
       y[k]   = C*x[k] + D*u[k]
       --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rMatrix_A11             : REAL := 0.9412;   (* Wall thermal inertia persistence *)
    rMatrix_A12             : REAL := 0.0385;   (* Wall-to-gas cross convective coupling *)
    rMatrix_A21             : REAL := 0.0821;   (* Gas-to-wall heat absorption coupling *)
    rMatrix_A22             : REAL := 0.8124;   (* Gas advective flow thermal decay *)
    
    rMatrix_B11             : REAL := -0.1542;  (* Chiller compressor power influence on wall *)
    rMatrix_B21             : REAL := -0.0125;  (* Direct refrigerant expansion impact *)

    rMatrix_E11             : REAL := 0.0150;   (* Mass flow thermal mass disturbance on wall *)
    rMatrix_E21             : REAL := 0.2850;   (* Mass flow direct warm gas convection input *)

    rMatrix_C11             : REAL := 0.0;      (* Output is directly the exit gas temperature *)
    rMatrix_C12             : REAL := 1.0;
    rMatrix_D11             : REAL := 0.0;

    (* State vectors *)
    rState_x1_WallTemp      : REAL := -38.0;    (* Internal estimated microchannel wall temperature [deg C] *)
    rState_x2_GasTemp       : REAL := -36.0;    (* Internal estimated microchannel gas temperature [deg C] *)
    rState_x1_Next          : REAL;
    rState_x2_Next          : REAL;
    rModel_PredictedGasTemp : REAL;

    (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) 2-STEP HORIZON QUADRATIC COST APPROXIMATION
       Cost Function: J = sum(Q * (y_k - r_target)^2 + R * (u_k - u_prev)^2)
       --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rMPC_Weight_Q           : REAL := 2.50;     (* Penalty on temperature tracking error *)
    rMPC_Weight_R           : REAL := 0.45;     (* Penalty on VFD compressor slew rate actuation *)
    rMPC_TargetTemp         : REAL := -40.0;    (* SAE J2601 T40 classification target [-40.0 deg C] *)
    rMPC_Error_0            : REAL;             (* Current step predicted error *)
    rMPC_Gradient           : REAL;             (* Cost function partial derivative dJ/du *)
    rMPC_Hessian            : REAL;             (* Cost function second derivative d2J/du2 *)
    rMPC_DeltaU             : REAL;             (* Optimal unconstrained control increment *)
    rVFD_SlewRateLimit      : REAL := 5.0;      (* Maximum actuator delta per cycle [%/s] *)

    (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       PRESSURE RAMP RATE (APRR) CALCULATOR & FILTER
       --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rPrevVehiclePressure    : REAL := 0.0;      (* Prior sample pressure for differentiation [bar] *)
    rRawPressureSlope_bar_s : REAL;             (* Instantaneous discrete derivative [bar/s] *)
    rAlpha_Filter           : REAL := 0.085;    (* First-order low-pass filter coefficient *)
    rFilteredSlope_bar_s    : REAL := 0.0;      (* Filtered slope [bar/s] *)
    rTargetFinalPressure    : REAL := 700.0;    (* Cutoff pressure: 350.0 or 700.0 bar *)
    rMaxAllowablePressure   : REAL := 875.0;    (* Overpressure trip envelope limit [bar] *)
    rInitialTankPressure    : REAL := 0.0;      (* Stored starting pressure after equilibration [bar] *)

    (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       CASCADE BUFFER BANK SWITCHING THRESHOLDS & HYSTERESIS
       --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rBankThreshold_LowToMid : REAL := 290.0;    (* Switch from Low to Mid bank when vehicle >= 290 bar *)
    rBankThreshold_MidToHi  : REAL := 520.0;    (* Switch from Mid to High bank when vehicle >= 520 bar *)
    rDeltaP_Minimum         : REAL := 35.0;     (* Minimum drive pressure differential [bar] *)
    iActiveCascadeBank      : INT := 1;         (* 1=Low, 2=Mid, 3=High *)

    (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       THERMAL JOULE-THOMSON & GAS COMPRESSIBILITY (NIST EOS REAL GAS DENSITY ESTIMATION)
       --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rCompressibility_Z      : REAL := 1.15;     (* Hydrogen high-pressure compressibility factor *)
    rDensity_kg_m3          : REAL;             (* Bulk density in vehicle tank *)
    rNominalDensity_Target  : REAL := 40.2;     (* Target density for 100% SOC (kg/m3 at 700 bar, 15C) *)
END_VAR

(*
====================================================================================================
  EXECUTIVE LOGIC EXECUTION BEGINS
====================================================================================================
*)

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 1: SAFETY INTERLOCKS AND EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN EVALUATION (IEC 61508 SIL-3 DEPLOYMENT)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemReady            := FALSE;
    bDispenseActive         := FALSE;
    bFaultTrip              := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord_01.0         := TRUE;            (* E-Stop Tripped Alarm *)
    bBankValve_Low_Open     := FALSE;
    bBankValve_Mid_Open     := FALSE;
    bBankValve_High_Open    := FALSE;
    bVentValve_Open         := FALSE;           (* Do not vent automatically unless commanded *)
    rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct   := 0.0;
    rVFD_ChillerSpeed_Pct   := 0.0;
    iState                  := 999;             (* Jump to Emergency Shutdown Lockout *)
END_IF;

IF NOT bBreakawayCoupled THEN
    bFaultTrip              := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord_01.1         := TRUE;            (* Breakaway Disconnected Alarm *)
    bBankValve_Low_Open     := FALSE;
    bBankValve_Mid_Open     := FALSE;
    bBankValve_High_Open    := FALSE;
    rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct   := 0.0;
    iState                  := 999;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) VOTING LOGIC
   Deterministic Median Selection with Drift Deviation Alarms for Pressure & Temperature
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Channel discrepancy delta calculations for Pressure *)
rPT_Diff12 := ABS(rPT_VehicleTank_1 - rPT_VehicleTank_2);
rPT_Diff23 := ABS(rPT_VehicleTank_2 - rPT_VehicleTank_3);
rPT_Diff31 := ABS(rPT_VehicleTank_3 - rPT_VehicleTank_1);

IF (rPT_Diff12 > 7.5) OR (rPT_Diff23 > 7.5) OR (rPT_Diff31 > 7.5) THEN
    bTMR_PT_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord_02.0     := TRUE;                (* TMR Pressure Sensor Drift Warning *)
ELSE
    bTMR_PT_Discrepancy := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord_02.0     := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Median Selection for 3-Channel Pressure *)
IF ((rPT_VehicleTank_1 >= rPT_VehicleTank_2) AND (rPT_VehicleTank_1 <= rPT_VehicleTank_3)) OR
   ((rPT_VehicleTank_1 <= rPT_VehicleTank_2) AND (rPT_VehicleTank_1 >= rPT_VehicleTank_3)) THEN
    rVoted_VehiclePressure := rPT_VehicleTank_1;
ELSIF ((rPT_VehicleTank_2 >= rPT_VehicleTank_1) AND (rPT_VehicleTank_2 <= rPT_VehicleTank_3)) OR
      ((rPT_VehicleTank_2 <= rPT_VehicleTank_1) AND (rPT_VehicleTank_2 >= rPT_VehicleTank_3)) THEN
    rVoted_VehiclePressure := rPT_VehicleTank_2;
ELSE
    rVoted_VehiclePressure := rPT_VehicleTank_3;
END_IF;

(* Channel discrepancy delta calculations for Pre-Chill Temperature *)
rTT_Diff12 := ABS(rTT_PreChill_1 - rTT_PreChill_2);
rTT_Diff23 := ABS(rTT_PreChill_2 - rTT_PreChill_3);
rTT_Diff31 := ABS(rTT_PreChill_3 - rTT_PreChill_1);

IF (rTT_Diff12 > 4.0) OR (rTT_Diff23 > 4.0) OR (rTT_Diff31 > 4.0) THEN
    bTMR_TT_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord_02.1     := TRUE;                (* TMR Pre-Chill Temperature Sensor Drift Warning *)
ELSE
    bTMR_TT_Discrepancy := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord_02.1     := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Median Selection for 3-Channel Temperature *)
IF ((rTT_PreChill_1 >= rTT_PreChill_2) AND (rTT_PreChill_1 <= rTT_PreChill_3)) OR
   ((rTT_PreChill_1 <= rTT_PreChill_2) AND (rTT_PreChill_1 >= rTT_PreChill_3)) THEN
    rVoted_ChillerTemp := rTT_PreChill_1;
ELSIF ((rTT_PreChill_2 >= rTT_PreChill_1) AND (rTT_PreChill_2 <= rTT_PreChill_3)) OR
      ((rTT_PreChill_2 <= rTT_PreChill_1) AND (rTT_PreChill_2 >= rTT_PreChill_3)) THEN
    rVoted_ChillerTemp := rTT_PreChill_2;
ELSE
    rVoted_ChillerTemp := rTT_PreChill_3;
END_IF;

(* Overpressure and Overtemperature Safety Triggers per SAE J2601 *)
IF rVoted_VehiclePressure > rMaxAllowablePressure THEN
    bFaultTrip          := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord_01.2     := TRUE;                (* Critical Tank Overpressure Detected *)
    iState              := 900;                 (* Abort to controlled depressurization *)
END_IF;

IF rVoted_ChillerTemp > -17.5 THEN
    wAlarmWord_02.2     := TRUE;                (* Chiller Gas Pre-Cool Warm Warning *)
    IF (iState >= 60) AND (iState <= 100) AND (rVoted_ChillerTemp > -10.0) THEN
        bFaultTrip      := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord_01.3 := TRUE;                (* Chiller T40 Temperature Envelope Violation Trip *)
        iState          := 900;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    wAlarmWord_02.2     := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 3: REAL-TIME AVERAGE PRESSURE RAMP RATE (APRR) COMPUTATION
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF rCycleTime_dt > 0.0001 THEN
    rRawPressureSlope_bar_s := (rVoted_VehiclePressure - rPrevVehiclePressure) / rCycleTime_dt;
ELSE
    rRawPressureSlope_bar_s := 0.0;
END_IF;
rPrevVehiclePressure := rVoted_VehiclePressure;

(* Low-pass exponential smoothing filter for APRR noise attenuation *)
rFilteredSlope_bar_s := (rAlpha_Filter * rRawPressureSlope_bar_s) + ((1.0 - rAlpha_Filter) * rFilteredSlope_bar_s);

(* Convert [bar/s] to [MPa/min]: (bar/s) * (0.1 MPa/bar) * (60 s/min) = * 6.0 *)
rActualRampRate_MPamin := rFilteredSlope_bar_s * 6.0;

(* Determine Target Ramp Rate Based on Protocol and Ambient Temperature *)
IF eTargetProtocol = 1 THEN
    rTargetFinalPressure    := 350.0;
    rMaxAllowablePressure   := 437.5;           (* 125% of nominal working pressure *)
    rTargetRampRate_MPamin  := 15.0;            (* H35 Standard Target Ramp *)
    rNominalDensity_Target  := 23.5;
ELSE
    rTargetFinalPressure    := 700.0;
    rMaxAllowablePressure   := 875.0;           (* 125% of nominal working pressure *)
    rTargetRampRate_MPamin  := 28.5;            (* H70 High Performance APRR Target *)
    rNominalDensity_Target  := 40.2;
END_IF;

(* Real-Time State of Charge (SOC) Calculation via Real Gas Law Approximation *)
IF rTargetFinalPressure > 10.0 THEN
    rCalculatedSOC_Pct := (rVoted_VehiclePressure / rTargetFinalPressure) * 100.0;
    IF rCalculatedSOC_Pct > 100.0 THEN
        rCalculatedSOC_Pct := 100.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCalculatedSOC_Pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 4: STATE-SPACE PRE-CHILL HEAT EXCHANGER MODEL EXECUTION
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* State prediction propagation: x[k+1] = A x[k] + B u[k] + E w[k] *)
rState_x1_Next := (rMatrix_A11 * rState_x1_WallTemp) + (rMatrix_A12 * rState_x2_GasTemp)
                  + (rMatrix_B11 * (rVFD_ChillerSpeed_Pct / 100.0))
                  + (rMatrix_E11 * rMassFlowRate_H2);

rState_x2_Next := (rMatrix_A21 * rState_x1_WallTemp) + (rMatrix_A22 * rState_x2_GasTemp)
                  + (rMatrix_B21 * (rVFD_ChillerSpeed_Pct / 100.0))
                  + (rMatrix_E21 * rMassFlowRate_H2);

(* Update state observer memory with bounded saturation protection *)
IF rState_x1_Next < -60.0 THEN
    rState_x1_WallTemp := -60.0;
ELSIF rState_x1_Next > 50.0 THEN
    rState_x1_WallTemp := 50.0;
ELSE
    rState_x1_WallTemp := rState_x1_Next;
END_IF;

IF rState_x2_Next < -60.0 THEN
    rState_x2_GasTemp := -60.0;
ELSIF rState_x2_Next > 50.0 THEN
    rState_x2_GasTemp := 50.0;
ELSE
    rState_x2_GasTemp := rState_x2_Next;
END_IF;

(* Observer Output Equation *)
rModel_PredictedGasTemp := (rMatrix_C11 * rState_x1_WallTemp) + (rMatrix_C12 * rState_x2_GasTemp);

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 5: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) REFRIGERATION VFD REGULATION
   Quadratic Cost Optimization to Hold Pre-Cool at -40.0 deg C (SAE J2601 Category T40)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rMPC_Error_0 := rModel_PredictedGasTemp - rMPC_TargetTemp;

(* Gradient calculation: dJ/du = 2 * Q * (y - y_sp) * dy/du + 2 * R * delta_u *)
(* Given dy/du ~ B21 = -0.0125, an increase in cooling VFD drives temperature downward *)
rMPC_Gradient := (2.0 * rMPC_Weight_Q * rMPC_Error_0 * (-0.15)) + (2.0 * rMPC_Weight_R * 0.05);

(* Hessian calculation: d2J/du2 ~ 2 * (Q * (dy/du)^2 + R) *)
rMPC_Hessian := (2.0 * ((rMPC_Weight_Q * 0.0225) + rMPC_Weight_R));

IF rMPC_Hessian > 0.001 THEN
    rMPC_DeltaU := - (rMPC_Gradient / rMPC_Hessian);
ELSE
    rMPC_DeltaU := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Constrain VFD slew rate and modulate chiller compressor *)
IF rMPC_DeltaU > (rVFD_SlewRateLimit * rCycleTime_dt) THEN
    rMPC_DeltaU := (rVFD_SlewRateLimit * rCycleTime_dt);
ELSIF rMPC_DeltaU < (-rVFD_SlewRateLimit * rCycleTime_dt) THEN
    rMPC_DeltaU := (-rVFD_SlewRateLimit * rCycleTime_dt);
END_IF;

rVFD_ChillerSpeed_Pct := rVFD_ChillerSpeed_Pct + rMPC_DeltaU;
IF rVFD_ChillerSpeed_Pct > 100.0 THEN
    rVFD_ChillerSpeed_Pct := 100.0;
ELSIF rVFD_ChillerSpeed_Pct < 15.0 THEN
    rVFD_ChillerSpeed_Pct := 15.0;      (* Minimum baseline lubrication speed *)
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 6: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) SEQUENCER
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE 0: IDLE AND STANDBY STATE *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bDispenseActive         := FALSE;
        bDispenseComplete       := FALSE;
        bFaultTrip              := FALSE;
        bBankValve_Low_Open     := FALSE;
        bBankValve_Mid_Open     := FALSE;
        bBankValve_High_Open    := FALSE;
        bVentValve_Open         := FALSE;
        rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct   := 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord       := 16#0000;
        wAlarmWord_01           := 16#0000;

        IF bStationEnable AND bBreakawayCoupled AND bEmergencyStop THEN
            IF bNozzleInterlocked THEN
                iState := 10;           (* Advance to Connection Verification *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: SAFETY, AMBIENT & PROTOCOL VERIFICATION *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#000A;
        bSystemReady      := FALSE;

        (* Check pre-chill chiller readiness before starting pulse *)
        IF rVoted_ChillerTemp <= -33.0 THEN
            tStepTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2S);
            IF tStepTimer.Q THEN
                tStepTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iState := 20;           (* Advance to Initial Pressure Pulse *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            (* Force chiller high cooling ramp to achieve pre-chill condition *)
            rVFD_ChillerSpeed_Pct := 95.0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: NOZZLE PURGE & INITIAL PRESSURE PULSE TEST *)
        wSystemStatusWord   := 16#0014;
        bDispenseActive     := TRUE;
        bBankValve_Low_Open := TRUE;    (* Use Low Bank for initial test pulse *)
        rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := 12.0;  (* Small metering opening for 50 bar pulse *)

        tPulseTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1S);
        IF tPulseTimer.Q THEN
            tPulseTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bBankValve_Low_Open   := FALSE;
            rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := 0.0;
            iState                := 30; (* Advance to equilibration *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: INITIAL PRESSURE EQUILIBRATION *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#001E;
        tStepTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
        IF tStepTimer.Q THEN
            tStepTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rInitialTankPressure := rVoted_VehiclePressure;
            iState               := 40; (* Proceed to Leak Check 1 *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: LEAK CHECK PHASE 1 (STATIC PRESSURE INTEGRITY HOLD) *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0028;
        bBankValve_Low_Open   := FALSE;
        rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := 0.0;

        tLeakHoldTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);
        IF tLeakHoldTimer.Q THEN
            tLeakHoldTimer(IN := FALSE);
            (* Verify pressure decay is within acceptable limit (< 1.5 bar drop) *)
            IF (rInitialTankPressure - rVoted_VehiclePressure) > 1.5 THEN
                bFaultTrip      := TRUE;
                wAlarmWord_01.4 := TRUE; (* Hose / Connection Leak Detected *)
                iState          := 900;
            ELSE
                iState          := 50;  (* Integrity verified; begin low bank dispense *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: CASCADE SELECTION ROUTING *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0032;
        IF rVoted_VehiclePressure < rBankThreshold_LowToMid THEN
            iActiveCascadeBank := 1;
            iState := 60;               (* Active Low Bank Ramping *)
        ELSIF rVoted_VehiclePressure < rBankThreshold_MidToHi THEN
            iActiveCascadeBank := 2;
            iState := 80;               (* Active Mid Bank Ramping *)
        ELSE
            iActiveCascadeBank := 3;
            iState := 100;              (* Active High Bank Ramping *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: ACTIVE RAMPING - LOW BANK CASCADE *)
        wSystemStatusWord   := 16#003C;
        bBankValve_Low_Open := TRUE;
        bBankValve_Mid_Open := FALSE;
        bBankValve_High_Open:= FALSE;

        (* APRR Closed-Loop Tracking on Mass Flow Control Valve (CV-101) *)
        IF rActualRampRate_MPamin < rTargetRampRate_MPamin THEN
            rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct + (0.85 * rCycleTime_dt * 10.0);
        ELSE
            rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct - (1.10 * rCycleTime_dt * 10.0);
        END_IF;

        (* Bounded Control Valve Positioning *)
        IF rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct > 85.0 THEN
            rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := 85.0;
        ELSIF rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct < 5.0 THEN
            rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := 5.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Bank Depletion / Pressure Differential Check *)
        IF (rVoted_VehiclePressure >= rBankThreshold_LowToMid) OR
           ((rPT_Bank_Low - rVoted_VehiclePressure) < rDeltaP_Minimum) THEN
            iState := 70;               (* Bank Switchover to Mid Bank *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: CASCADE BANK SWITCHOVER LOW TO MID *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0046;
        (* Bump-less transfer: Close Low, hold CV, open Mid *)
        bBankValve_Low_Open := FALSE;
        tBankSwitchHoldTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#500MS);
        IF tBankSwitchHoldTimer.Q THEN
            tBankSwitchHoldTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bBankValve_Mid_Open := TRUE;
            iActiveCascadeBank  := 2;
            iState              := 80;  (* Advance to Mid Bank Ramping *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE 80: ACTIVE RAMPING - MID BANK CASCADE *)
        wSystemStatusWord   := 16#0050;
        bBankValve_Low_Open := FALSE;
        bBankValve_Mid_Open := TRUE;
        bBankValve_High_Open:= FALSE;

        (* APRR Closed-Loop Tracking *)
        IF rActualRampRate_MPamin < rTargetRampRate_MPamin THEN
            rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct + (0.75 * rCycleTime_dt * 10.0);
        ELSE
            rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct - (1.00 * rCycleTime_dt * 10.0);
        END_IF;

        IF rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct > 90.0 THEN
            rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := 90.0;
        ELSIF rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct < 5.0 THEN
            rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := 5.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Check Mid Bank Depletion or Target Threshold reached *)
        IF (eTargetProtocol = 1) AND (rVoted_VehiclePressure >= (rTargetFinalPressure - 5.0)) THEN
            iState := 110;              (* H35 Target Reached; Final Check *)
        ELSIF (rVoted_VehiclePressure >= rBankThreshold_MidToHi) OR
              ((rPT_Bank_Mid - rVoted_VehiclePressure) < rDeltaP_Minimum) THEN
            iState := 90;               (* Bank Switchover to High Bank *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE 90: CASCADE BANK SWITCHOVER MID TO HIGH *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#005A;
        bBankValve_Mid_Open := FALSE;
        tBankSwitchHoldTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#500MS);
        IF tBankSwitchHoldTimer.Q THEN
            tBankSwitchHoldTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bBankValve_High_Open := TRUE;
            iActiveCascadeBank   := 3;
            iState               := 100; (* Advance to High Bank Dispense *)
        END_IF;

    100: (* STATE 100: ACTIVE RAMPING - HIGH BANK CASCADE (TOP-OFF PHASE) *)
        wSystemStatusWord   := 16#0064;
        bBankValve_Low_Open := FALSE;
        bBankValve_Mid_Open := FALSE;
        bBankValve_High_Open:= TRUE;

        (* Fine APRR ramp control approaching top-off pressure *)
        IF (rTargetFinalPressure - rVoted_VehiclePressure) < 50.0 THEN
            (* Slew down ramp rate to prevent pressure overshoot *)
            IF rActualRampRate_MPamin > (rTargetRampRate_MPamin * 0.4) THEN
                rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct - (1.50 * rCycleTime_dt * 10.0);
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            IF rActualRampRate_MPamin < rTargetRampRate_MPamin THEN
                rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct + (0.65 * rCycleTime_dt * 10.0);
            ELSE
                rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct - (0.95 * rCycleTime_dt * 10.0);
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct > 95.0 THEN
            rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := 95.0;
        ELSIF rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct < 3.0 THEN
            rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := 3.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Check Final Target Fulfillment: Pressure or Density Target SOC *)
        IF (rVoted_VehiclePressure >= rTargetFinalPressure) OR (rCalculatedSOC_Pct >= 99.5) THEN
            bBankValve_High_Open  := FALSE;
            rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := 0.0;
            iState                := 110; (* Transition to Final Pressure Hold *)
        END_IF;

    110: (* STATE 110: FINAL HIGH-PRESSURE VERIFICATION & LEAK CHECK 2 *)
        wSystemStatusWord     := 16#006E;
        bBankValve_Low_Open   := FALSE;
        bBankValve_Mid_Open   := FALSE;
        bBankValve_High_Open  := FALSE;
        rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct := 0.0;

        tLeakHoldTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4S);
        IF tLeakHoldTimer.Q THEN
            tLeakHoldTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 120;              (* Refueling cycle complete *)
        END_IF;

    120: (* STATE 120: REFUELING COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY *)
        wSystemStatusWord       := 16#0078;
        bDispenseActive         := FALSE;
        bDispenseComplete       := TRUE;
        bBankValve_Low_Open     := FALSE;
        bBankValve_Mid_Open     := FALSE;
        bBankValve_High_Open    := FALSE;
        rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct   := 0.0;
        rVFD_ChillerSpeed_Pct   := 20.0; (* Ramp down chiller to standby speed *)

        IF NOT bStationEnable OR NOT bNozzleInterlocked THEN
            bDispenseComplete   := FALSE;
            iState              := 0;    (* Return to IDLE *)
        END_IF;

    900: (* STATE 900: CONTROLLED SYSTEM ABORT AND VENTING *)
        wSystemStatusWord       := 16#0384;
        bDispenseActive         := FALSE;
        bBankValve_Low_Open     := FALSE;
        bBankValve_Mid_Open     := FALSE;
        bBankValve_High_Open    := FALSE;
        rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct   := 0.0;
        bVentValve_Open         := TRUE; (* Safely bleed dispenser dead-leg *)

        tStepTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#8S);
        IF tStepTimer.Q THEN
            tStepTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bVentValve_Open     := FALSE;
            iState              := 999;  (* Latch into lockout state *)
        END_IF;

    999: (* STATE 999: SAFETY SHUTDOWN & LOCKOUT *)
        wSystemStatusWord       := 16#03E7;
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bDispenseActive         := FALSE;
        bBankValve_Low_Open     := FALSE;
        bBankValve_Mid_Open     := FALSE;
        bBankValve_High_Open    := FALSE;
        bVentValve_Open         := FALSE;
        rCV_MassFlowValve_Pct   := 0.0;
        rVFD_ChillerSpeed_Pct   := 0.0;

        (* Reset Lockout requires explicit cycling of enable with healthy permissives *)
        IF NOT bStationEnable AND bEmergencyStop AND bBreakawayCoupled THEN
            bFaultTrip          := FALSE;
            wAlarmWord_01       := 16#0000;
            wAlarmWord_02       := 16#0000;
            iState              := 0;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
